\LNOTES FOR STAIRS:
*	ALL STAIR  STEEL ELEMENTS AND WOODEN STEPS TO BE DESIGNED BY THE CONTRACTOR.
*	STEEL TO STEEL AND STEEL TO CONCRETE CONNECTIONS SHALL BE DESIGNED AND DETAILED BY THE CONTRACTOR
             BASED ON THE DESIGN FORCES FOUND IN THE CONTRACTOR DETAILED DESIGN
*	CONTRACTOR HAVE TO PROVIDE THE FINAL REACTIONS FROM THE DETAILED DESIGN MODELS OF STEEL STRUCTURE
            TO VERIFY THE DESIGN OF THE SUPPORTING CONCRETE BEAMS / COLUMNS.
*	LIVE LOADS CONSIDERED ON STAIRS TO BE 4.80 kN/m,AND THE SUPER IMPOSED DEAD LOAD TO BE CALCULATED APPROXIMATELY ACCORDING TO THE SELF WEIGHT OF ALL STEEL ELEMENTS ,WOODEN STEPS AND FINISHES .
